translations.en: you remained in the town.
There was no longer any need to think of fleeing in haste.
Now you could go wherever you liked, whenever you liked.
Above all, there were still many adventures left here.
You there, adventurer.
I have a job that calls for your skills.
Would you take it on?
It's a bit of a problem.
There may be another labyrinth waiting to be discovered.
If you're interested, would you at least hear me out?
Ah, such fine adventurers.
I have a feeling you can handle this.
Would you hear what @7rBeatrix@0r has to say
and lend her a hand?
I'm counting on you too.
The adventure surrounding @7rChu Lu Gah@0r's imprisoning curse was over,
but a new adventure was about to begin.
What new adventure
awaited you next?
That was a story for another time...
It looks like all the regulars are here.
The tavern's bustling again today.
You looked up at her words. In their usual places sat
@7rCarmine@0r, @7rCyrus@0r, @7rTanya@0r, @7rAnselm@0r,
and @7rFiore@0r, each making themselves comfortable.
Since that strange incident with the light,
the grudges that had set them against one another had vanished,
and everyone had united around one goal: saving the town.
That strange light
seems to have been visible to the people of this imprisoned town too.
Honestly, I don't know what to do now.
But we have to do something.
This has already become more than just this town's problem...
Yes. If the true story of @7rChu Lu Gah@0r is right,
the demon god that destroyed the town will turn on the outside world next.
Indeed, what enveloped this town was no curse,
but a seal to reinforce the ancient imprisonment of something.
And now that seal was beginning to break.
I'm counting on your help.
You've already gotten yourself this deeply involved,
so I doubt you'll suddenly decide to run away now.
When the time comes, I'll work you hard, so be ready.
Hm? Hellooo!
Has there been any progress?
Well? Well?
Sigh... @7rFiore@0r. If we'd made any progress
or come even one step closer to solving this,
I wouldn't look like this.
Oh. Well, I suppose that's true.
Anyway, give me a job if anything comes up!
Yes, yes. As I said earlier,
I'm counting on you and @7rFiore@0r if anything happens.
Or is there something you want to ask?
Something to ask...
Her words brought a question to mind.
About the light
The sealed demon god
When you asked if there was any more information about the light,
@7rBeatrix@0r shook her head regretfully.
What was that light we saw?
Honestly, we haven't figured it out either.
I thought the light might have appeared
because the seal had broken, but it seems the seal is still there.
To be frank, I'm completely baffled.
One possibility is that there are several seals, and one broke,
causing that strange light.
Or perhaps, at the moment it broke, a small gap opened in the seal,
and a tiny bit of something leaked out...
As for the demon god rumored to have been sealed away,
we don't know anything specific about it either.
"Demon god" is a term people use
to make it easier for everyone to understand what was sealed away.
It could actually have been something else.
Even if it was something else, I imagine it would be as dangerous as a demon god,
or perhaps worse...
Once we've made some progress investigating it,
I'll explain it properly.
Apart from that, the only new thing we've learned
is that the ruins of another town have been found.
Whether that was also caused by the light is still a mystery.
